newsitem.title: USA: Sierra Health acquiring Physician Corp. for $434 million.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Health acquiring Physician Corp. for $434 million.

text.p: Sierra Health Services Inc. said Monday it was acquiring Physician Corp. of America in a $434 million stock deal that will create the nation's eighth-largest publicly traded managed health care company.

Sierra Health Services said it would offer 0.45 of its own shares for each of the 39.2 million outstanding shares of Physician Corp., a Miami-based managed care company with operations in Florida, Texas and Puerto Rico.

Based on Sierra's stock price of $24.625 on the New York Stock Exchange, where it lost $4.25 in morning trading, the deal would be worth about $434.4 million and value Physician Corp. at about $11.08 a share. Physician Corp.'s stock gained 25 cents to $10.875 on the Nasdaq market.

Sierra, which is based in Las Vegas, said its combination with Physician Corp. will create a company with more than $2 billion in annual revenues serving nearly 1.5 million people in 18 states and Puerto Rico.

The company said Stanley Kardatzke, M.D., now chairman and chief executive of Physician Corp., will become chairman of the new company and Sierra Chairman Anthony M. Marlon will serve as vice chairman and chief executive.
Erin MacDonald, currently president and chief operating officer of Sierra, will remain in those positions, it added.

"This merger represents an excellent strategic opportunity for Sierra to gain a strong multi-state presence," Marlon said in a statement. "We will be able to substantially broaden our existing service area in Texas and become one of the market leaders in Florida and Puerto Rico."

The announcement said the combined company will be named Sierra Health Services Inc., with national headquarters in Las Vegas. The merger is expected to close by March 31, pending normal shareholder and regulatory approvals.
It also said the eight-member board of directors of the combined company will consist of Sierra's five current directors, plus three members appointed by Physician Corp.
